verdict.rationale: Mangopay's first-party docs describe a webhook feature that sends notifications to other applications when a specific event occurs on a specific API object. Subscribing is done per event type in the Dashboard (Developers > Webhooks > Add webhook, select event type, enter URL). Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog, delivery and retry guarantees, signature verification, API-based programmatic subscription management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
